checkpoints.october: November 1 00:00, skip if season has not started

training_snapshots: Every historical game, all inputs strictly before its calendar date; no same-day results.
test_snapshots: Freeze ratings, rotations and team strength at checkpoint. Evaluate all subsequent games and actual playoff matchups, conditional on future fixtures, not a replay of an archived schedule.
player_rating: Prior-season regular-season BPM only, shrunk toward -2 with 500 pseudo-minutes; never current-season final BPM.
minutes: Mean minutes in team's last five already-played games, counting absences as zero. Before five games, fill missing games with prior-season team-stint MPG. Normalize projected team minutes to 240. No current game's actual lineup or minutes.
roster: Prior regular-season last observed team, updated only after an already-played appearance on another team. Offseason trades/rookies unknown until observed; no current final roster.
team_strength: Schedule-adjusted regular-season margins using a 20-game ridge prior on previous season SRS. Solve using only results strictly before date. Subtract fixed 3-point home adjustment; 2020 bubble neutral.
series: Exact best-of-seven win DP, 2-2-1-1-1 (Finals through 2013: 2-3-2). Home court projected from checkpoint records + SRS, not eventual results; bubble neutral. Rest difference fixed to zero for possible series games.
baselines: SRS logistic game model: same pre-date team strength and home court, prior seasons only
Current SRS series logistic baseline: existing historical d_srs series rows, prior seasons only; invert iid best-of-seven curve for game probabilities
bootstrap: 2000 paired whole-season resamples; overlapping checkpoint forecasts remain in the same season cluster
promotion_rule: Keep candidate only if game log-loss paired 95% upper delta < 0; game Brier, series log loss and series Brier improve; log loss improves in at least two-thirds of seasons for BOTH games and series; at least two checkpoint types improve game log loss; game ECE worsens by no more than 0.005. All comparisons are with vs without player strength. No automatic production changes.
